title: Deposit 1 ETH in a vault through a proxy

steps.title: Alice calls the proxy with 1 ETH
steps.body: Alice calls deposit on the proxy and sends 1 ETH along with the call.

steps.title: The proxy borrows the vault logic
steps.body: The proxy has no code of its own, so it runs the code of VaultLogic on its own values.
steps.gist: The proxy has no code of its own and runs the borrowed code on the proxy's values

steps.title: The vault checks it is not paused
steps.body: The borrowed code checks that the vault has not been paused.

steps.title: A call that only reads the price
steps.body: The borrowed code asks PriceOracle for the price. Nothing can be written inside this call.
steps.gist: Nothing can be written inside a read-only call

steps.title: PriceOracle returns the price
steps.body: PriceOracle returns the current price of ETH.

steps.title: The deposit is written to the proxy
steps.body: The borrowed code writes to the values of the proxy, not of VaultLogic.

steps.title: The borrowed code ends
steps.body: The code of VaultLogic finishes and control goes back to the proxy.

steps.title: The proxy records the deposit
steps.body: The proxy emits an event saying who deposited how much.

steps.title: The deposit ends
steps.body: The outermost call returns, and the ETH sent and the value written both become final.
steps.gist: The ETH transfer and the written values become final when the outermost call returns
